data_dir.description: Path to the directory containing RIG's index data files (locdata.idx, street.idx, etc.).

identity_count.description: The number of random identities to generate in a single run.

gender.description: Gender constraint for generated names: 'male', 'female', or 'both'.

output_format.description: The format of the output: 'plain' (whitespace separated), 'csv', or 'json'.
